blocks.text: Communities ecosystems mein rehti hain. Ecosystem mahol ke biotic (zinda) hisson aur abiotic (be-jaan) hisson, jaise dhoop, mitti, paani aur hawa, se mil kar banta hai. Ecosystem mein tawanai (energy) sirf ek simt mein behti hai (unidirectional), jabke ghizai ajza (nutrients) zinda aur be-jaan hisson ke darmiyan chakkar lagate rehte hain.

Maslan Thar Desert (registan) ek bohat bara ecosystem hai. Is mein sirf saanp, kaale hiran (blackbucks) aur jhaariyan (community) hi nahin, balke jhulsa dene wali garmi, jagah badalte ret ke teele aur kabhi kabhar ki barish (abiotic factors) bhi hain jo wahan rehne wale jandaron ke rehne sehne par asar dalte hain.
